message.content:
**Kin** usually means your **family** or **relatives**—people you are related to by blood or marriage.[1][2]

It can also be used more broadly to mean a **group of people with common ancestry** or your **closest relations**.[1][2]

If you meant **“kin”** in internet slang, it can also refer to a character or person you strongly **relate to**, but that usage is informal and not the standard dictionary meaning.[3][4]
